title: Golden contracts
description: The app's compatibility-contract goldens, extra golden paths and the approved pixel tolerance, read by the golden-and-snapshot-tests checkers. Optional while no golden test has a [contract] describe; required (check-goldens contract-unregistered) as soon as one does. Without it the marker is [contract], the golden paths are the defaults and the pixel tolerance is 0.001. It is itself a golden path: it belongs in quality-gates.json gatedPaths and changes only in a Gate-Change commit.

contracts.description: Output every installed version must reproduce exactly (a stored or exchanged format, a derived identifier, a date-keyed pick). Each one is pinned by a golden test with a describe title that carries a contract marker. An app without such output keeps an empty list.

test.description: Repo-relative path of the *.golden.test.ts file that pins it.

why.description: Who depends on the output staying identical (installed versions, other devices, files users keep).

goldenPaths.description: Extra repo-relative globs that count as golden paths: they need a Gate-Change trailer (check-golden-changes) and must be in quality-gates.json gatedPaths (check-goldens). Examples: '**/*.vectors.json', 'src/data/**/fixtures/**'.

contractMarkers.description: Text that marks a contract golden in its describe title and so in every snapshot key (default ['[contract]']). Add a marker only for goldens that already carry another one; never rename a contract title.

maxPixelTolerance.description: The highest failureThreshold (percent type) the pixel matcher may hold: 0.001 (0.1% of pixels) by default. Raise it only after the reviewer agreed, together with the matcher, in a commit whose trailer says 'approved by <reviewer>'.
